description: This file is a server-side entry point for a Remix application, handling HTTP requests, server rendering with React, and differentiating between bot and browser requests.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main exported function to handle incoming HTTP requests, sets CORS headers, manages bot vs. browser requests.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering specifically for bot (crawler) user-agents, streams HTML response.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser user-agents, streams HTML response.
